# requires: wire
#
# `Content-Encoding: gzip` on a body nobody asked to have compressed. A request
# that sends no Accept-Encoding has, by RFC 9110, accepted every coding, so this
# is a legal answer -- and the transport underneath each language then decides
# on its own whether the bytes handed up are the artifact's or the envelope's.
# An offset over an encoded body names a different byte at each end, which is
# why a ranged request asks for identity.
submit A size=64 digest=good src=http:gzip
run A alpha
orphans
state A

# expect 2: transfer-failed state=pending [DL-R11]
# expect 2: done=0 err=set
# expect 3: ok A [DL-R12]
